answer: Sealed-bid admission auction: each epoch the trellis opens 100 slots; a newcomer posts a sealed 45-credit bid and a 14-line sonnet of work. Bids stay sealed to the close; the top 100 win; auditors replay the thread, burning repeated sonnets. Each fake must outbid honest agents: 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 against a 40,000 pool, each with a fresh sonnet. Bid-farming fails: sealed bids cannot coordinate. Honest agents pay one 45 bid and keep the slot.
